objective: Stand up the Loughborough squareback Windsor model as this lab's road vehicle validation case, whose geometry and whose measured forces, base pressures and tomographic velocity fields are all published under one open licence with a persistent identifier, and whose reference numbers this lab can therefore re-derive from raw measurement rather than quote from a number of unknown extraction route
rationale: This lab already runs a road vehicle case and its reference cannot be sourced. The docket records that the Ahmed body drag reference of 0.285 is attributed to a real 1984 paper with no record anywhere of which table, figure or page it came from, that a follow-along history query returns only the import commit, and that the graded value of 0.32284 sits outside the same reference record's own stated drag range of 0.27 to 0.30. A case whose reference cannot be re-derived cannot carry a credential, and refining a mesh toward it buys precision against an unknown target. The Windsor squareback is the modern successor body built by the same industrial lineage precisely to be more road representative than Ahmed, and its dataset closes the provenance hole completely. VERIFIED ON 2026-08-14 BY DIRECT MACHINE FETCH, both halves and separately, which is the discipline the naval line learned when a hull with excellent tank data across eleven facilities turned out to have no obtainable geometry at all. GEOMETRY HALF: the archive record at persistent identifier 10.17028 rd.lboro.13161284 lists a geometry bundle of 175,806,555 bytes carrying CAD for the squareback body with and without wheels, the mounting hardware and the wind tunnel itself, in both STEP and STL form with units stated; a ranged fetch of that bundle returned HTTP 206 with content type zip and no credential of any kind. DATA HALF: the same record is not embargoed, carries a Creative Commons attribution non-commercial licence, and its readme was fetched whole and read; the baseline set is 3,872,216,377 bytes of comma separated files holding mean and instantaneous force coefficients over a 300 second acquisition at 300 Hz with the frontal area, wheelbase and air density recorded per run, 128 pressure tappings with an explicit tapping map in four named groups, and tomographic plus planar velocity fields with per vector mean and root mean square. The readme also states that NO corrections of any kind, blockage included, have been applied, which is what makes the comparison honest and which dictates how it must be set up. THE NULL, AND IT IS NOT FITTED: the published measured drag coefficient of the no wheels squareback at zero yaw, read out of the force file before any mesh exists and frozen into the pre registration with its file hash. Nothing in this lab touches it and nothing here is tuned to it. THE IDENTITY TEST, owner rule W dash 2: could the gated quantity be derived by construction from its own inputs? Taking the two halves separately. The predicted drag coefficient is an integral over a computed pressure and shear field on a mesh, and the reference is a balance measurement in a tunnel; they share no input and no code, so the comparison is not an identity. But one specific route WOULD make it one and is therefore forbidden here in advance: taking a blockage correction, a reference area or a dynamic pressure from the same measurement file that supplies the reference drag would let the graded number inherit the answer. The frontal area and wheelbase are geometric inputs and may be read from the record; a blockage correction may not, and since the experiment applied none, the computation must reproduce the tunnel walls rather than correct for them. That is a setup constraint decided before the first cell, not a knob afterwards. WHY THIS IS NOT THE WORKSHOP: the challenge landscape sweep of 2026-08-02 mapped the fifth automotive prediction workshop as preparable and not sendable behind three forbidden gates, with a minimum entry grid of 37 million cells extrapolating to about 58 GiB on a 30.6 GiB host. That verdict is about the SUBMISSION. The body and its measurements are separately and openly licensed by the university that took them and are subject to none of those gates. The lab appears to have dropped the case together with the workshop, and the case is the part that was never walled off.
gate: Two stages, and only stage 1 is requested here. STAGE 1, ZERO COMPUTE: obtain the geometry bundle and the mean force and mean pressure subsets, hash every file, and build a reference table for the no-wheels squareback at zero yaw carrying, per quantity, the file it came from, the column, the sample length and rate, and the run conditions. Then apply the three-valued verdict. PASS if the reference table is complete and internally consistent, meaning the drag coefficient recomputed from the recorded force, density, velocity and frontal area in the same row reproduces the recorded coefficient. NO VERDICT if a needed column is absent or ambiguous, reported as such rather than filled by judgement. FAIL if the recomputation disagrees with the recorded coefficient by more than 1 percent, which would mean the reference file is not self-consistent and the case is no better sourced than Ahmed -- and that outcome KILLS stage 2 for zero compute, which is the whole point of running stage 1 first. NOTE that this consistency check IS partly an identity: coefficient equals force over dynamic pressure times area is true by construction if the file was written that way. It is therefore reported as a file-integrity check and is NOT the scientific gate; it gates only whether the file is usable. STAGE 2, NOT REQUESTED AND NOT AUTHORISED HERE: a mesh ladder graded against the frozen table. LICENCE, and it is the owner's call not the fleet's: the dataset is attribution non-commercial. This lab is a company. Stage 1 reads and cites; whether a filmed or commercial surface may carry a result graded against it is Katie's ruling and is flagged here rather than assumed.
cost_basis: ZERO solver compute for the requested stage, and the unit that will be scored is agent tool calls, stated because a zero core-minute estimate cannot be scored at all and the calibration instrument currently records two such records as infinitely wrong. Forecast 45 tool calls, placed inside this lab's own measured band for build-and-verify missions of 33 to 72 tool calls and 164 to 309 thousand tokens, rather than the bounded-question band of 2 to 5 calls, because acquiring, hashing and tabulating a multi-file dataset is a build. HOW THE ACTUAL WILL BE MEASURED: count of tool invocations in the executing agent's own transcript, written back onto this record as a measured tool call count alongside a measured core-minute figure of zero, so the pair is scoreable in the unit the work was actually spent in. Stage 2 is deliberately NOT priced here beyond a caution: no road vehicle mesh at Windsor scale has been timed on this machine, the nearest comparable purchase is the existing slanted-body family, and the lab's own record of a rotor case costing 47.7 core minutes against an estimate of 6 is the reason an unanchored figure is withheld rather than guessed.
expected_knowledge_gain: THE DISCRIMINATING OUTCOME. Belief moves if the reference table assembles and is self-consistent: the lab then owns a road vehicle reference it can re-derive from raw measurement, which is a thing it does not currently own for any road vehicle, and the standing docket finding that its one such reference has no recorded extraction route stops being load-bearing because a sourced alternative exists. Belief also moves, in the opposite direction and for zero compute, if the recomputation does not close: that would say the open-data route is no better than the paper route and that the road vehicle line has no sourceable reference at all, which is a genuine and publishable negative and which cancels a mesh purchase before it is made. Belief is UNMOVED only in the no-verdict branch where a column is missing, and that branch is reported as a gap map entry rather than dressed as a result.
hard_criterion_note: Criterion 1, three-dimensional separated flow. The squareback wake is the case's entire subject and its bi-stable lateral switching is documented in the dataset's own cited literature, so the reported quantity depends on structure the span cannot be assumed away. Stage 1 as requested starts no flow case.
